nodes.rationale: AI execution is fast; the real bottleneck is human review and cross-layer dependencies, so the legacy 6-hour rule is replaced by ~60 min.

nodes.label: Afan (Karvey spiral principle)
nodes.rationale: You don't stop until the result is really achieved; nothing is dropped.

nodes.label: Writers vs router separation
nodes.rationale: Separating observation from routing keeps loop logic in one place (karvey-iterate).

nodes.label: knowledge_sync mechanism (obsidian | graphify)
nodes.rationale: Never go without synchronization; graphify is the guaranteed floor.

nodes.label: Phase-close ritual (comment, state, sweep, spec.json+knowledge)
nodes.rationale: ClickUp updates as a 'should' got skipped; making it a mandatory numbered step prevents stale tasks.

nodes.label: Iteration loop (spiral, not a line)
nodes.rationale: Pipeline is the happy path; findings route to bug / spec-gap / emergent so nothing gets dropped or stays in the air.

nodes.label: karvey-statusline.sh (rotation statusline)
nodes.rationale: Installed by hand because a plugin cannot declare a statusline; runs outside the turn so costs no tokens.

nodes.label: Agent handoff (handoff.md + state.json)
nodes.rationale: A lone agent rotates too and has the least safety net.

nodes.label: Decision log D-NN / C-NN with cross-check
nodes.norm_label: decision log d-nn / c-nn with cross-check
nodes.rationale: Every entry carries what it does NOT say to prevent over-applying a decision.

nodes.label: 18 verification failure modes
nodes.rationale: A citation is not the thing cited; exit 0 is not success; green test over uncalled code.

nodes.label: 6-agent 3-day run evidence (~US$1,000, 7x turn cost, 13/14 blocks already answered)
nodes.norm_label: 6-agent 3-day run evidence (~us$1,000, 7x turn cost, 13/14 blocks already answered)
nodes.rationale: Every hop between sessions is new context with no shared cache; background re-read and re-paid on each side.

nodes.norm_label: release 3.8.0 — agent handoff, team layer, verification

nodes.label: Optional team layer (opt-in, not default)
nodes.rationale: Teams are first-class option but not default; ships with counter-evidence so the next person chooses with the number in front of them.

nodes.label: 150k context rotation threshold
nodes.rationale: At 588k a turn costs 7x vs 80k; rotation (~40k re-read) amortizes in under half a turn.

nodes.norm_label: method readiness checks (skills installed, input drift)

nodes.norm_label: agent addressing: names are not identifiers

nodes.label: Commit by explicit path in shared working copy
nodes.norm_label: commit by explicit path in shared working copy
nodes.rationale: Shared index means a plain commit takes others' staged work.

nodes.label: Session rotation (context_threshold / max_session_hours)
nodes.rationale: A long session drifts and is the last to notice; an agent cannot rotate itself.

nodes.label: docs/spec/team.json (opt-in team layer)
nodes.rationale: A 6-agent experiment cost ~US$1,000 in 3 days and went back to one agent; each hop is new context, so default to one agent.

nodes.label: Agent handoff (captured by commands)
nodes.rationale: Handoff state section is command output, not composed from memory; works for one agent or a team.

nodes.label: Team cost warning (~US$1,000 / 3 days / 6 agents)
nodes.rationale: Each session hop is new context with no shared cache; a 588k-context turn costs 7x an 80k one, so teams are opt-in.

nodes.label: Optional team layer
nodes.rationale: Opt-in, not the default: Karvey is complete with one agent; measured run cost ~US$1,000 over 3 days with 6 agents and ended back on a single agent.

nodes.label: Mockup navigation levels 1-4
nodes.rationale: Deeper mockups (3-4 levels) make spec mistakes visible early; shallow mockups hide wizards, confirmations and error states.

nodes.label: bug -> BUG-NN incident tracker + QA micro-loop
nodes.norm_label: bug -> bug-nn incident tracker + qa micro-loop

nodes.label: Causal discipline: what CHANGED before what is WRONG
nodes.norm_label: causal discipline: what changed before what is wrong
nodes.rationale: Post-mortem: a pre-existing fragile path was reported as root cause; real cause was a CSP security header change. A cause predating the incident window cannot explain the symptom.

nodes.label: Iron Law: no fix without root-cause investigation
nodes.norm_label: iron law: no fix without root-cause investigation

nodes.label: Git host detection (project.json:git_platform)
nodes.rationale: Deploy platform and git host differ; hardcoded gh CLI failed on Azure Repos/GitLab.

nodes.label: Hotfix lane (fix + BUG-NN + regression test same PR)
nodes.norm_label: hotfix lane (fix + bug-nn + regression test same pr)

nodes.label: approvals.prod {by, date, ref}
nodes.rationale: Keeps prod approval in git history where the platform cannot enforce required reviewers.

nodes.norm_label: release 3.9.0 — branch hygiene, standards conformance, pr gates

nodes.label: Branch hygiene (nothing left in branches)
nodes.rationale: Absorbed branches deleted remote+local in the same deploy; absorption verified (git branch --merged, git cherry, tree test), never assumed. Stale branches read as pending work and hide real unreleased work.

nodes.label: Documentation drift (counts, hooks, stale rule copies)
nodes.norm_label: documentation drift (counts, hooks, stale rule copies)
nodes.rationale: Three phase skills were reading outdated copies of shared rules — a silent behavior bug, not just docs.

nodes.label: Git host detection (gh / az repos / glab)
nodes.norm_label: git host detection (gh / az repos / glab)

nodes.norm_label: release gate (qa 0 critical/high, tests pass, changelog)

nodes.label: Human owner + AI-assisted traceability block
nodes.rationale: Minimal traceability of who/when/why; AI assistance explicit but the human is never replaced by 'AI'.

nodes.label: Semantic versioning major.minor.rev
nodes.rationale: Never deploy without incrementing the version.

nodes.label: Branch hygiene — nothing left in branches
nodes.norm_label: branch hygiene — nothing left in branches
nodes.rationale: A branch that outlives its merge reads as pending work; absorption verified, never assumed.

nodes.label: Ordered deployment feature -> dev -> PR master
nodes.norm_label: ordered deployment feature -> dev -> pr master
nodes.rationale: Pipeline-triggered, PR gates verified before prod OK, canary post-deploy and branch hygiene.

nodes.norm_label: archiving protocol (merge deltas into living specs)

nodes.norm_label: ears patterns (ubiquitous, event-driven, state-driven, conditional, optional)

nodes.label: Deviation Request (design mode escalation)
nodes.rationale: The agent never resolves a departure from the standard silently.

nodes.rationale: A spec-gap re-opens requirements and ripples forward only the affected phases.

nodes.label: Pinned inputs from other agents (@commit)
nodes.rationale: Every cross-agent dependency is a pinned, verifiable reference, never 'the other agent already did it'.

nodes.label: Engineering standards layer (golden paths)
nodes.rationale: Method specified what to build but had no canonical place for how; architecture/impl drifted on tribal knowledge.

nodes.label: PR gates verification before prod OK
nodes.norm_label: pr gates verification before prod ok
nodes.rationale: The method took you to production's door and never checked whether it opened.

nodes.label: QA Dimension 9 — Standards conformance
nodes.rationale: A gate that is never verified is not a gate; departures without deviations.md entry are High blocking findings.

nodes.label: Method/standards separation (two planes)
nodes.rationale: Public plugin stays generic; team standards live in the team's own (possibly private) repo.

nodes.label: Method vs standards planes
nodes.rationale: The public plugin must never contain team data; standards live in the team's own repo.

nodes.label: Two planes: public method vs team standards repo
nodes.norm_label: two planes: public method vs team standards repo

nodes.label: BL-01 Run graphify over the repo
nodes.norm_label: bl-01 run graphify over the repo
nodes.rationale: project.json:knowledge_sync = graphify was never run; owner wanted repo left ordered. Done 2026-09-22: 82 files -> 399 nodes, 753 edges, 21 communities; .graphify_python ignored.

nodes.label: graphify-out knowledge graph
nodes.rationale: Knowledge graph of the method itself (project.json:knowledge_sync = graphify), repo-relative paths, refreshed with graphify . --update.

nodes.label: Karvey Method (spec-driven development)
nodes.rationale: Karvey = Ona/Selknam word for Afán (zeal); stack-agnostic SDD method for Claude Code synthesizing first-hand experience with ideas from Kiro and gstack (conceptual inspiration only, no code).

nodes.label: Sweep is not silent
nodes.rationale: Silent truncation reads as 'everything is captured' when it isn't.

nodes.label: Branch hygiene (delete absorbed branches)
nodes.rationale: A branch that outlives its merge is a trap; only absorbed branches are deleted, unreleased work is reported, never cleaned silently.

nodes.label: Approval marker / override
nodes.rationale: A skill is only guidance; PreToolUse hooks block deterministically.

nodes.label: Engineering standards (golden paths)
nodes.rationale: Third source of truth for how the team builds, so architecture/impl don't lean on tribal knowledge.

nodes.label: Iron Law: no fix without investigating
nodes.norm_label: iron law: no fix without investigating

nodes.label: Cross-cutting support skills layer
nodes.rationale: Inspired by gstack's virtual team; support skills never advance the phase (except karvey-iterate backward).

nodes.label: targets field (stack agnosticism)
nodes.rationale: No phase assumes web by default; verification happens in the target's real runtime.

nodes.label: Close external PRs workflow
nodes.rationale: Karvey does not accept PR contributions; non-owner PRs are auto-closed and redirected to Discussions because the method is a HainTech trademark (fork allowed under Apache-2.0).

nodes.label: SessionStart hook (karvey-session-context.sh)
nodes.rationale: Active on install; reinjects agent handoff and reports matches/DRIFT against live repos; inert without a handoff.

nodes.label: Karvey trademark (HainTech)
nodes.rationale: Code license does not grant trademark rights; name and karvey-* convention reserved to HainTech.

nodes.label: Cross-cutting support skills layer
nodes.rationale: Support skills invokable any time; they do not advance the phase.

nodes.norm_label: time_estimate via rest api (mcp does not save it)

nodes.label: Change goal (north star)
nodes.rationale: Provides persistence: every phase re-reads the goal to pursue the result until achieved, respecting plan and security gates.

nodes.rationale: Each phase produces a document under docs/spec/ and asks for an OK before advancing (approval gates).
